objective: Make automated scientific verification measurably trustworthy, execution-grounded, and useful across real computational research.
invariants: Optimize selective correctness, not completion rate.
Reported numeric values may not influence output-locator selection.
Known public benchmark cases are diagnostic unless explicitly held out.
False passes are treated as more costly than abstentions.
Model judgments may guide discovery but never directly award a scientific verdict.

tracks.name: AgnXiv Bench 100
tracks.target: 100 independently selected papers with stratified difficulty and full failure taxonomy

tracks.name: Selective verification and abstention
tracks.target: maximize verification coverage subject to a <=1% empirical false-pass target on labeled cases

tracks.name: Execution-grounded paper-code discrepancy detection
tracks.target: outperform static paper+code baselines using evidence graphs and executable probes

tracks.name: Environment archaeology
tracks.target: recover minimal publication-era environments for broken historical repositories

tracks.name: Central-claim identification
tracks.target: verify scientifically central claims before incidental metrics

tracks.name: Leakage-free observation discovery
tracks.target: select the correct output without access to the reported numeric answer

tracks.name: Paper lineage reconstruction
tracks.target: recover implementation details inherited from cited work

tracks.name: Independent reimplementation
tracks.target: separate author-code reproduction from independently implemented evidence

tracks.name: Conflicting evidence aggregation
tracks.target: represent correlated and independent replications without a universal truth score

tracks.name: Adversarial scientific verification
tracks.target: stress-test hardcoded metrics, prompt injection, path attacks, seed gaming, leakage and sandbox-aware behavior

tracks.name: Cross-domain generalization
tracks.target: extend beyond ML into physics, quantitative biology and other computational sciences

external_anchors.name: PaperBench

external_anchors.name: RECLAIM
external_anchors.use: Run/Retrain/Reimplement difficulty tiers and target-result reproduction

external_anchors.name: AgentActionBench
external_anchors.use: process-oriented action evaluation and ML/AI4Science coverage

external_anchors.name: ReproRepo
